# Security Policy

## Reporting Security Vulnerabilities

If you discover a security vulnerability in Bridge Protocol, please **do not** open a public issue. Instead:

1. Email the security details to: `security@your-domain.com`
2. Include a detailed description of the vulnerability
3. Provide steps to reproduce (if applicable)
4. Include your contact information

We will respond within 48 hours to acknowledge your report and work with you to resolve the issue.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | ✅ Yes             |
| develop | ✅ Yes             |
| < 0.1   | ❌ No              |

## Security Best Practices

When developing with Bridge Protocol:

1. Keep dependencies updated
2. Use environment variables for sensitive data
3. Validate user input on both client and server
4. Use HTTPS in production
5. Follow the principle of least privilege
